title: The Silenced Violin
brief:
Intermission at the concert hall, the foyer is buzzing. When the soloist Marta Weil returns to her dressing room at 20:50, her violin case is empty. The dressing room's motion sensor was triggered exactly once during the intermission: at 20:40.

Find out who took the violin with their own hands. The suspects are Ida Reiner, Paul Adler, Kurt Mohn, Vera Lind and Henrik Sand. Search the rooms, examine what you find, and question Ida, Paul, Kurt and Vera. Not every lead points to the culprit, and not every answer is true.
challengeQuestion: Who took the violin from the dressing room at 20:40?

questionTexts.text: Was Paul Adler in the foyer at 20:40?
questionTexts.answer: Yes, Adler was in the foyer holding court, as always.

questionTexts.text: Was Henrik Sand in the VIP box at 20:40?
questionTexts.answer: Yes, Mr Sand was sitting in his VIP box at 20:40.

questionTexts.text: Was Ida Reiner on stage at 20:40?
questionTexts.answer: No. Ida was not on stage at 20:40, I'm sure of that.

questionTexts.text: Were you in the boiler room at 20:40?
questionTexts.answer: Yep, at 20:40 I was down in the boiler room.

questionTexts.text: Did you check the control cabinet in the boiler room during the intermission?
questionTexts.answer: Sure, I checked the control cabinet, like every intermission.

questionTexts.text: Was Paul Adler in the dressing room at 20:40?
questionTexts.answer: I reckon the conductor was in the dressing room, yes.

questionTexts.text: Was Ida Reiner on stage at 20:40?
questionTexts.answer: Ida on stage? Could be, could also not be.

questionTexts.text: Were you in the foyer at 20:40?
questionTexts.answer: Of course. At 20:40 I was in the foyer.

questionTexts.text: Was Ida Reiner on stage at 20:40?
questionTexts.answer: Yes, Ms Reiner was on stage at 20:40.

questionTexts.text: Were you in the dressing room at 20:40?
questionTexts.answer: In the dressing room? No, certainly not.
Yes, at 20:40 I was on stage.

questionTexts.text: Were you in the dressing room at 20:40?
questionTexts.answer: In the dressing room? No, really not.

questionTexts.text: Was Paul Adler in the dressing room at 20:40?
questionTexts.answer: Paul? No, he wasn't in the dressing room.

publicRules.text: Whatever a find with a timestamp shows counts as fact. Statements by people can be mistaken.
The violin was taken from the soloist's dressing room at 20:40 by exactly one person. Anyone who was provably somewhere else at 20:40 is ruled out.
Only Ida Reiner, Paul Adler, Kurt Mohn, Vera Lind and Henrik Sand are suspects. If four are ruled out, the fifth person remains.

epilogue:
Ida Reiner confesses. “For twelve years I sat behind her,” she says. “Just once I wanted to play the solo.” At 20:40, when everyone was standing in the foyer, she took the violin from the dressing room. Under questioning she lied: she claimed she had been on stage and had not entered the dressing room.

Paul Adler and Vera Lind can be seen in the press photo from the foyer, Henrik Sand was on the phone in the locked VIP box, and Kurt Mohn was logged in at the control cabinet in the boiler room at that very minute. The grey hair on the violin case was a false lead: Paul had carried the case during setup in the afternoon.
